description: Find channels whose name contains a substring (case-insensitive). Returns { matches: [...], hiddenChannels } with the id, name and type of every match, active threads included. Channels that Discord hides from the bot behind the placeholder name ___hidden___ are left out of matches and counted in hiddenChannels; when it is above 0, a note field says a channel missing from matches may still exist. The list is empty when nothing matches. Useful for resolving a channel_id when you only know the channel's name. Use discord_list_channels to see every channel grouped by category.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against channel names.

name: discord_find_channel_by_name
